shots.purpose: Prove the sachet has a built-in filter.

shots.purpose: Show water hitting the grounds; the edit compresses the repeated pours and steep.

shots.movement: Slow push-in as the bloom rises; a 50 fps pour insert.

shots.purpose: Make the light-to-dark range concrete with the named packs.

alternatives: Call it instant coffee in a convenience comparison
Lead with the roast origin story
decisions.rationale: Blue Tokai explicitly separates Easy Pour from instant coffee. The category word and a visible pack avoid a false comparison.

decisions.selected: Demonstrate tear, anchor and first pour; compress the repeated pours and steep with a disclosure.
alternatives: Show the whole brew as a 20-second real-time take
Skip the demo and use pack beauty shots
decisions.rationale: The built-in filter is the product benefit. A real action proves it, and a labelled time-lapse keeps the 20-second format honest.

decisions.selected: Hero the Mixed Bag and show Seethargundu, Attikan and Vienna as range support.
alternatives: Hero Vienna as the darkest roast
decisions.rationale: The Mixed Bag is the first-time buyer's variety route. Four packs communicate light to dark with a real light endpoint and a dark endpoint, without turning the frame into a catalogue.

decisions.selected: Keep price and pack size out of the ready cut.
alternatives: Use the price as the hook
Hold the price for a later approved version
decisions.rationale: The values are observed but not approved, and the hero pack size is still unresolved. Price would turn observation into an ad claim.

decisions.selected: Build a 16:9 500-frame YouTube master with early branding.
decisions.rationale: The brief asks for a 20-second YouTube ad. A 16:9 master fits in-stream, while the pack and brand appear from the first shot.

decisions.selected: Use the public image URLs as observed sources and hold rights.
decisions.rationale: The supplied links identify the exact product, but public access does not grant paid-media use. Stand-ins would break exactness.

assumptions: The master is 16:9 because the brief asks for a YouTube ad.
Safe insets are conservative operator assumptions pending placement preview.
The real brew includes a two-minute steep; the film compresses it and discloses that.
Public product image URLs are observed references, not cleared assets.
Inter is a placeholder until Blue Tokai supplies its brand typeface.
